potency_replications.verification: Full text read 2026-10-01 (ScienceDirect, Dongguk institutional access). Peptides synthesized by solid phase (433A), HF cleavage, homogeneous on RP-HPLC; Table 2 lists synthetic IC50 values including Ile-Tyr 2.65 uM. Same assay family as Sato 2002 (HHL 12.5 mM, rabbit-lung ACE, 228 nm). Takahisa Nakano (Riken Vitamin) co-authored both this paper and Sato 2002 (10.1021/jf020482t); the values differ (2.65 vs 6.1 uM) and the measuring groups differ (Suetsuna lab vs Tohoku Univ.). Counted as an independent paper by team-lead decision 2026-10-01. pIC50 gap to Sato IY 0.36.

potency_replications.verification: Full text read 2026-10-02 (Elsevier PDF, kept outside the repository). Ten dipeptides isolated from the wakame hot-water extract, each a separate HPLC peak, sequenced by Edman degradation with amino acid ratios and FAB-MS; Table 1 gives the IC50 of the isolated dipeptides, and the synthetic peptides served only the rat study. Independent group (National Fisheries University, Takata Seiyaku, Taipei Medical University) from the scallop paper (Li et al. 2018, Dalian). The 2026-09-30 review excluded it under the synthetic-only rule; purified peptides count since the team-lead decision of 2026-10-01. Its pIC50 is 0.906 from the scallop VW (86.9 uM). 3/3 independent verifiers passed it on 2026-10-02.
